chunks: What has come upon you that you judge in such a wise?
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about the method of judging in Surah Al-Qalam?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this rhetorical question highlights the fallibility of human judges who rely on personal opinion (ra'y) rather than divine revelation or the teachings of the Ahl al-Bayt. It serves as a foundational critique of legal subjectivity, urging rulers to anchor their verdicts in the established principles of justice and the Sunnah of the Prophet and his Imams.
